item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi rgyud las zhi rgyas gnyis kyi mchod mdel
item.coloph: ces 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi zhi rgyas sbyin sreg gi mchod mdel 'di nyid/ sgrub pa chen po'i skabs su 'kho gal la brten/ grogs kyis bskul bzhin kho bo rat+na gling pas bris pa dge bar gyur cig/
